name: buyback-insider-conviction-pipeline
title: Buyback Insider Conviction: 8-K Repurchase Plus Insider Buys
description: For each ticker, finds 8-K share repurchase announcements and correlates them with insider open-market buying around the filing, scores conviction 0 to 100, and tiers each as conviction_buyback, accumulation, or watch. A buyback plus insiders buying is the signal. Pure EDGAR data, no keys.
